note: The identifier of a template, derived from its key (nothing stored): `t` and the first 12 hexadecimal digits (lower case) of the SHA-256 of the key in UTF-8, line breaks LF. The ids below were computed with Python's hashlib, not with the C#. A real collision cannot be written as a case (it needs two keys with the same 48 bits): the checks force one with a small id function (TemplateIdsChecks).

cases.why: the id is `t` and the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of the key
UTF-8, not a code page: accents are bytes of the key
a key holding a line break is hashed with an LF
even the empty key has an id: nothing is special-cased
a key with no closed slot is no template: nothing to collide
two different templates have two ids
the same template listed twice is not a collision
